title: Schrijf een brief aan een webwinkel over de latere levering van haar verpakkingen
person: A customer manager at a small Flemish printing house writing to a web shop that orders its boxes there.
review: It answers the web shop's e-mail of 1 October, gives the new delivery date of 30 October with the reason, and offers the 5 per cent reduction.
revised_review: The delivery date is 6 November everywhere; 30 October appears nowhere.

criteria.text: Every mechanical check in run.py passes for this stage.
The address sits in the window on the right, where bpost's zones put it.
The address is written as bpost reads it: the postcode and the municipality last, the municipality in capitals.
The date is written out in Dutch.
The closing takes a comma when the salutation has one.
Subject, closing and signatory are in the letter, as its spec names them.
The seat, the enterprise number and RPR with the court are on the letter.
It gives the new delivery date, the reason (the cutting die arrived late) and the 5 per cent reduction on this order.

source: Synthetic material created for this evaluation pack; the companies, people, prices and addresses are invented.
stage_policy: Separate first and revision directories; reveal revision only after first output is frozen.
